name: Pyroclasm (Recharge 5–6)
description: Gouts of molten lava erupt from the creature’s body. Each creature in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the creature must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature takes 21 (6d6) fire damage and 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage. On a successful saving throw, a creature takes half as much damage.
